blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Refusing to suffer the same fifth-set heartbreak, Trisha Tubu took matters into her own hands to bring back Farm Fresh to its winning ways in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Conference. After being limited in the first four sets, Tubu poured in seven of her 14 points to lead Farm Fresh’s reverse sweep of Choco Mucho, 20-25, 26-28, 25-23, 25-23, 15-13, on Thursday night at Mall of Asia Arena.
